rationale: The inspected official 43-page document is titled Notice of Proposed Amendment 2025-07(B) and labels the material Proposed DS.AI. Its provisions include operating domain/risk work, system development assurance, supervised-ML learning assurance, configuration and lifecycle data, and in-service monitoring. Calling it a substantial candidate lifecycle is appropriate because the claim does not call it final or sufficient for the worked case.

limitations: The review checked the cited NPA but did not establish a final EASA decision, comment-resolution publication, or adopted AMC/GM edition.
Coverage named in a proposed framework does not show that all evidence obligations are operationalised for a DAA case.
